description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class 'DeleteOneToOneDatatableEntryCommandHandler' that implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface. Its primary responsibility is to handle commands for deleting entries from a one-to-one datatable by invoking the 'DatatableWriteService'.

classes.name: DeleteOneToOneDatatableEntryCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that processes delete commands for datatable entries, implementing the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface.

methods.description: Handles the incoming command to delete datatable entries by delegating to 'DatatableWriteService'.
